voiceIdle: Your response team, one conversation away.
voicePrivacy: Audio goes to your selected provider. Team responses are generated simulations; no emergency service is contacted.
noise: Echo cancellation and noise suppression requested
noiseHint: Browser support varies; this does not verify speaker identity.
speakerHint: Live timing estimates only. Speaker numbers do not identify people; overlap and noise can be uncertain.
speakerUnavailable: Speaker analysis unavailable; voice can continue.
clipHint: Up to 60 seconds / 8 MB. Review before sending. Audio remains in this browser until you send it for transcription.
clipError: Recording could not be completed. Check microphone access and try again.
audioError: Audio playback unavailable. The written response remains available.
incidentPlaceholder: Describe the situation or steer the active response…
steerHint: New directions are saved immediately. Work from older revisions is marked superseded.
simulationHint: Generated advisory roles. No dispatch, messages, posts, or fundraising transactions are sent.
activityHint: Actual requests, persisted events and results. This is not private model reasoning.
noTasks: Start an exercise to see each team’s progress.
consentRequired: Open the route preview and explicitly consent before sharing coordinates.
